overloads.semanticRole: The DISPLAY NOTIFICATION command displays a notification message to the user.

constraints: title and text are each limited to 255 characters.
Under macOS (10.8+), the notification is only shown while the application is not in the foreground, though it still appears in Notification Center regardless.
Under Windows, the notification remains displayed until machine activity is detected or the user clicks its close box; duration overrides this default display behavior.
Actual display of notifications also depends on the OS/system notification configuration.
